analyzed_vuln.description: The PoV-specific UAF is caused by ownership misuse in the fuzz harness: it allocates a decoder list (`list`) and passes it to `flb_parser_create`, which on some failure paths calls `flb_parser_destroy` and frees `parser->decoders` via `flb_parser_decoder_list_destroy`. The harness then enters its `fuzz_parser == NULL` cleanup branch and unconditionally calls `flb_parser_decoder_list_destroy(list)` again, producing a double-destroy/use-after-free in `flb_parser_decoder_list_destroy` when iterating a freed list head.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Input must drive the harness to create a non-NULL decoder list (the decoders option enabled), and also make `flb_parser_create` fail after taking ownership of that list (e.g., invalid parser configuration from fuzzed fields). In that case `flb_parser_create` internally frees the list through `flb_parser_destroy`, returns NULL, and the harness performs a second destroy on the stale pointer in its error cleanup path, triggering the ASan heap-use-after-free.
